claims.claim: Born in Buenos Aires on 8 June 1957
claims.note: Buenamusica biography gives 8 June 1957, Buenos Aires.

claims.claim: Telefe announced 24 contestants for MasterChef Celebrity in September 2026; Lerner was one of them
claims.note: Announcement dated 9 Sep 2026; cast list includes Alejandro Lerner.

claims.claim: Discovered by Raul Porchetto in 1974 and invited to Reino de Munt, a short-lived group
Around 1977 briefly with Soluna, Gustavo Santaolalla's band
Joined Sandra Mihanovich's group in 1980 as pianist and singer
Formed La Magia in 1981-1982; group split in 1982 and he began a solo career
'Todo a pulmon' released as a single in 1983
Travelled to the United States in 1985 to study music and jazz
In 1985 received a Konex award as a rock composer of the decade
claims.note: Source: Premio Konex (Autor/Compositor de Rock de la Decada).

claims.claim: 'Juntos para siempre' was the theme of La banda del Golden Rocket in 1990
Album Amor infinito came out in 1993
La Nacion, November 2001: life split between Argentina and the United States; about eight years in US hotels; album Magic hotel named after one of them
claims.note: Article dated 24 Nov 2001: 'Durante ocho anos... vivia en un hotel'; 'Tanto que le puse ese nombre a un album'.

claims.claim: Wrote 'El poder de los suenos', a song for Disney's radio network across Latin America
claims.note: Source says it airs on the Disney radio network across Latin America.

claims.claim: Attention in the US came in 2002 when he sang 'Hoy es adios' with Carlos Santana
Compilation 20 anos in 1999; 'Campeones de la vida' won a Martin Fierro the same year
Albums Si quieres saber quien soy (2000), Lerner vivo (2002), Buen viaje (2003), Canciones para gente nina (2006), Enojado (2007), En vivo Gran Rex (2011), Autentico (2016), Bailando (2016)
claims.note: All years match the Buenamusica entries.

claims.claim: 'Los suenos del ayer' was the soundtrack of Cuentame como paso, released in 2017
Wanda Nara hosts; jury is Damian Betular, German Martitegui and Maru Botana
Pia Shaw confirmed his participation on A la Barbarossa; reported by Cronica in September
Quote: vertigo at first, 'because I had to face my own ignorance. Then I plucked up courage'
claims.note: Source: 'me tuve que enfrentar a mi ignorancia'; 'Despues me anime'.

claims.claim: He studies at home, watching YouTube videos and taking notes
Quote: 'I am not afraid of getting it wrong, not at all. But I want to learn'
claims.note: Source: 'No tengo miedo de equivocarme, para nada. Pero quiero aprender.'

claims.claim: Hot oil from his pan hit jury member Maru Botana's face in an elimination gala reported on 6 October 2026
claims.note: Article dated 6 Oct 2026; splash reached Botana's face.

claims.claim: His dish was among the three lowest rated that night
claims.note: Source: 'Su propuesta quedo entre las tres peor evaluadas'.

claims.claim: He stayed in the competition
Eliminated fourth from MasterChef Celebrity on Tuesday 27 October 2026
The challenge was a lemon pie, and most contestants made errors
In the final duel he faced Grego Rossello, whose dish was also among the weakest that night
claims.note: Source names both as the two least successful dishes.

claims.claim: The jury voted him out
claims.note: Canal26: 'por mayoria'. Rio Negro says unanimous. The article states no margin, so the claim holds.

claims.claim: He said he had a nervous crisis and confused egg whites with yolks
claims.note: Canal26: 'una crisis nerviosa'; Rio Negro: egg whites and yolks.

claims.claim: Jury said his dough was undercooked, the lemon filling had the wrong consistency, and the proportions were wrong
claims.note: Betular: masa poco cocida; Martitegui: errors in quantities; cream consistency.

claims.claim: Asked about his plate, he said it was ugly but his own
In his farewell he said he felt like a student again
claims.note: Source: 'volver a sentirse como un estudiante'.

claims.claim: Fellow contestants applauded him and performed one of his songs
claims.note: Source: hugs, applause and a performance of one of his songs; performer not named.

claims.claim: Summary, knownFor and metaDescription describe him as a singer-songwriter
claims.note: Konex record lists him as author/composer and performer of his own songs; role descriptor only, no nationality.

claims.claim: FAQ: 69 years old as of 29 October 2026
FAQ: born in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on 8 June 1957
claims.note: Birthplace from Buenamusica; country is geographic, not a nationality claim.

valueNote: Timeline from the 1974 discovery through the 2026 elimination, with the Telefe programme details, the La Nacion context and the press quotes. Nationality is no longer asserted.
summary: Approved. Every body, summary, knownFor and FAQ claim is confirmed by a fetched source. Nationality descriptors removed; the Konex wording, Telefe-page citation, milanesa and unsupported 1993 songs were fixed in earlier rounds.
